description: List public upcoming events from a Luma discover city feed. Pass a city name (resolved for you) or a place_id from luma_places. Optional keyword filters event name/venue/calendar client-side. Never returns guest lists or attendee data.

city.description: City name or slug, e.g. "San Francisco" or "sf". Resolved to a Luma place_id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous call's next_cursor (ignored when query is set).

place_id.description: A Luma discover place_id (e.g. "discplace-BDj7GNbGlsF7Cka") from luma_places. Use instead of city.

query.description: Optional keyword to filter by event name, venue or organizer (matched client-side; paginates up to 200 events to find matches).

name: luma_events
title: Luma Events
